name: FUEL_FOOD_BED_THIS_EXIT_BLUE_LONG

service_fuel.desc: Fuel pump service symbol (bowser with hose), 800x800 box; see AS 1743 Appendix B; drawn 656x635 ink centred in its 800x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

service_food.desc: Crossed spoon and fork service symbol, 640x800 box; see Appendix B; drawn 467x635 ink centred in its 640x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

service_accommodation.desc: Bed service symbol, 960x800 box; see Appendix B; drawn 836x673 ink centred in its 960x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

notes: 3240x1800 R300; blue 50 / white 50 (100/50). 260 | 800 symbols | 160 | 320 E | 260 = 1800. Symbols 260 | 800 | 160 | 640 | 160 | 960 | 260; THIS EXIT 494 | 1026 | 240 | 986 | 494. Service symbols: the drawing dimensions the symbol boxes (service_fuel 800x800 at 260,260; service_food 640x800 at 1220,260; service_accommodation 960x800 at 2020,260); the pictograms do not fill them, so each element box is the pictogram's ink extent measured from the drawing, centred in the dimensioned box (nominal_box).
